known_issues.text: CDK keeps the first copy of a duplicated spending-condition tag instead of rejecting the proof as NUT-11 requires. The fix was merged upstream on 16 Nov 2026; mints pass once they run a CDK release that includes it.
known_issues.label: CDK fix merged, upgrade when released

known_issues.text: Nutshell versions before 0.21.0 accept duplicated spending-condition tags. Fixed in Nutshell 0.21.0; upgrading the mint fixes it.
known_issues.label: fixed in Nutshell 0.21.0: upgrade

known_issues.text: CDK 0.18.x reads a witness without a preimage as a P2PK witness, so it refuses the HTLC refund path (the refund key's signature alone, after the locktime). Fixed on CDK main in #2641 (October 2026), not yet in a release; a backport is requested in cdk#2980. Found by Mintprobe.
known_issues.label: fixed on CDK main, upgrade when released

known_issues.text: CDK doesn't send the first notification for a proof it has never seen, although NUT-17 requires the current state (UNSPENT) first. A fix is in review in cdk#2983. Found by Mintprobe.
known_issues.label: CDK fix in review
